FINEMAP_archive.transport_note: HTTP from official provider after retained HTTPS certificate failure; hash pins exact bytes but no independent provider digest or TLS-authenticated binary retrieved.

Reference_LAPACK_and_reference_BLAS.version_metadata_note: Official tag v3.12.1 archive selected. Its root CMakeLists still says PATCH_VERSION 0; exact tag/archive hash is authoritative pin, built runtime version reporting must be checked.

numerical_environment.BLAS: Reference BLAS bundled with official Reference-LAPACK tag v3.12.1, LP64 integer ABI, single threaded
numerical_environment.LAPACK: Reference-LAPACK official tag v3.12.1, archive hash as above
numerical_environment.floating_point_build: No fast-math or unsafe reassociation; ordinary IEEE rounding. Proposed GCC/gfortran 12.3.0; compiler binary/hash and actual linked shared objects must be recorded in execution environment.

input_contract.variant_prior: Uniform 1/p across retained eligible locus variants; no candidate, functional, regulatory, gene or model-derived information.
input_contract.statistics: Immutable ordered signed beta/SE/z and compatible ordered signed correlation matrix; no P-only reconstruction or arbitrary allele flips.
input_contract.sample_size: Track/locus-specific scalar n or justified likelihood-specific effective n must be approved from source statistic/sample contract; never automatically substitute total or 4/(1/Ncase+1/Ncontrol). Per-variant N preserved and heterogeneity reviewed.
input_contract.z_method: UNRESOLVED_PER_TRACK. Use wald only for validated ordinary Wald z; score only after source-score covariance and scaling contract is defensible. SAIGE SPA-quantile z must not be relabeled a Gaussian score simply because an API has this option.
input_contract.matrix_repairs: None: no nearest-PSD, ridge, sign correction by residual improvement, band zero-fill, or arbitrary diagonal replacement.
input_contract.in_sample_LD_exception: No automatic residual-variance switch; a future separately frozen approved in-sample design would be required.

primary_susieR.effect_prior_note: Prespecified standard per-effect variance optimization initialized at0.2; this does not estimate nonuniform variant priors. No mixture or functional prior learning.
primary_susieR.purity_note: Exact all-variable min/mean/median absolute Pearson r for supplied correlation input; r threshold0.5 is not r-squared0.5 and is not an LD-origin eligibility gate. Preserve low-purity sets as QC failures.
primary_susieR.control_note: Mismatch-specific settings pinned for reproducibility but inactive under R_mismatch=none/R_finite=NULL. No automatic mismatch correction is introduced.
primary_susieR.maf_note: No extra internal MAF filter; only prospectively approved variant ledger.
primary_susieR.failure_policy: Nonconvergence, exhausted signal cap, invalid ELBO or unstable/impure/boundary-spanning output remains unresolved; no result-driven signal cap/tolerance tuning.

future_signal_cap_sensitivity.rule: If independently authorized, apply identically across eligible loci and retain all configurations; never choose by biological desirability.

sensitivity_FINEMAP.input_scope: Same ordered variants, allele orientation, beta/SE and LD as approved primary locus input
sensitivity_FINEMAP.priors: No --prior-snps and no --prior-k: documented uniform per-SNP prior1/p with default induced configuration prior, truncated at maximum10. Prespecified prior-std0.05.
sensitivity_FINEMAP.corr_config_note: Algorithm restriction on pairs within a causal configuration; not LD pruning and not matrix repair.
sensitivity_FINEMAP.seed_status: UNRESOLVED: official1.4.2 documentation and static executable option inspection expose no configurable seed flag. No fictional --seed option or deterministic-run claim. A provider-supported reproducible seeding route must be resolved before invoking stochastic search under the preflight seeded-repeat requirement.
sensitivity_FINEMAP.source_compilation_lineage: Provider distributes binary. Static dependency inspection retained; exact compiler and internal numerical library build provenance unavailable and must not be equated with the separately proposed R BLAS.

pre_execution_software_blockers: Build and validate R/core packages against frozen archives; freeze full R dependency lockfile and exact dependency source/binary hashes (Matrix,matrixStats,mixsqp,reshape,crayon,ggplot2,Rfast,cpp11,cpp11armadillo plus transitive dependencies).
Record exact compiler/runtime/shared-library hashes and verify R sessionInfo(), extSoftVersion(), BLAS/LAPACK linkage, source version and matrix precision. No installed runtime has been claimed.
Resolve provider-supported FINEMAP stochastic seed control or separately approve an explicit reproducibility exception; current binary has no documented seed flag.
Verify FINEMAP binary authenticity through acceptable independent/provider route because local frozen binary came from official HTTP after HTTPS certificate failure.
Close each track-specific likelihood/z_method/sample-size contract and every locus input gate; no executable scientific command is created in this stage.

clearance_scope_clarification.note: Each proposed track and locus must pass every applicable input gate before its execution. One cleared track may proceed after separate investigator authorization; success of all three tracks is not required.
clearance_scope_clarification.existing_stage_freeze_binding: No final stage freeze or config-specific hash receipt found before this wording clarification.
